findings.description: The Lambda environment contains a plaintext AWS access key ID and secret access key. These values are embedded in Terraform configuration and function configuration, making them available to code and principals permitted to retrieve the Lambda configuration; if valid, they enable unauthorized AWS API access.
The function uses Node.js 12.x, an end-of-life runtime that no longer receives security updates. This leaves the function exposed to known and future runtime vulnerabilities.
